name: plamo-ja
description: Run /plamo on to have Claude reply in English and see each reply in Japanese, translated by PLaMo 3 Translate on a local OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio, llama.cpp); /plamo on-input also sends your Japanese prompts in English; /plamo off shows the English again

endpoint.title: API base URL
endpoint.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server; /completions is appended. LM Studio defaults to http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name as the server knows it (the model key in LM Studio)

form.title: Japanese style
form.description: polite: です・ます, plain: だ・である
